intended_use: Architecture screening and data-contract tests only. Not an engine calibration map, batch certificate, fuel specification, emissions factor, lifecycle result, or permission to operate.
critical_rules: Keep original published values and units alongside normalized values.
AFDC does not publish a standard uncertainty for the displayed values; uncertainty remains unknown, not zero.
Do not convert volumetric LHV to mass-based LHV without a density value at a declared reference temperature and a traceable source or batch measurement.
The AFDC renewable-diesel category is not proof that an individual batch is HVO or compatible with a given engine.
A fuel-family label does not establish materials compatibility, ignition strategy, emissions performance, or legal approval.
Production calculations must use batch-specific measured or accepted certified properties, not these screening defaults.

normalization.energy_units: Btu values normalized to MJ/L for volume-based rows or MJ/kg for mass-based rows.
normalization.convention: Btu_IT conversion convention used for SI normalization; raw AFDC values retained for audit.

sources.title: Alternative Fuels Data Center — Fuel Properties Comparison
sources.authority: U.S. Department of Energy, Alternative Fuels Data Center
sources.source_notes: Fuel properties comparison table, row: Energy Content (lower heating value). The AFDC notes that values vary by region, fuel mix and feedstock.

sources.title: 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2, Chapter 1, Table 1.2
sources.source_notes: Default net calorific values and lower/upper 95% confidence interval bounds. Gas/diesel oil default 43.0 TJ/Gg, lower 41.4, upper 43.3.

records.label: Low sulfur diesel
records.applicability: U.S. AFDC comparison value; not a South African batch specification.

mass_basis_alternative.note: Default gas/diesel oil value. Keep separate from AFDC volumetric value; it is not a measured conversion of the same batch.

records.label: Renewable diesel (AFDC category)
records.applicability: AFDC reference category. Do not relabel every renewable-diesel product as HVO; feedstock and processing pathway vary. No mass-basis LHV supplied in this record.

records.label: Biodiesel B100
records.applicability: B100 reference value only; do not transfer to blends or different feedstocks without a batch specification.

records.label: Biodiesel B20
records.applicability: B20 reference blend; blend composition and property acceptance must be verified for the actual batch.

records.label: Compressed natural gas
records.applicability: AFDC comparison gas composition. Real CNG composition and heating value vary by source and renewable-gas blending.

records.label: Liquefied natural gas
records.applicability: AFDC reference LNG composition; actual LNG composition and density are batch/source dependent.

records.label: Ethanol E100
records.applicability: E100 reference; water content and denaturant/specification must be represented for an actual batch.

records.label: Methanol
records.applicability: AFDC reference value; purity, water content, storage and material compatibility remain separate properties.

records.label: Hydrogen
records.applicability: Gravimetric fuel energy only; storage system mass/volume, compression/liquefaction energy and upstream production are not included.

records.label: Propane/LPG reference
records.applicability: AFDC propane-majority LPG reference; actual LPG composition and pressurized storage state are separate.
